news.headline: Boston Scientific Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Boston Scientific Corporation reported Q3 2026 net sales of $5.138 billion and adjusted EPS of $0.73, while providing updated full-year and fourth-quarter financial guidance.

news.headline: Boston Scientific Lowers FY2026 Adj EPS Guidance from $3.28-$3.32 to $3.16-$3.18 vs $3.23 Est; Lowers FY2026 Sales Guidance from $21.178B-$21.379B to $20.927B vs $21.143B Est
Boston Scientific Sees Q4 Adj EPS $0.77-$0.79 vs $0.84 Est; Sees Sales $5.127B-$5.233B vs $5.404B Est

news.summary: Vertiv reported strong third-quarter 2026 financial results, exceeding analyst expectations for revenue and earnings, and subsequently raised its full-year 2026 guidance.

These Analysts Slash Their Forecasts On Robinhood After Q3 Results
news.summary: Robinhood beat Q3 estimates with record $1.424B revenue and 60¢ EPS, trimmed 2026 expense guidance; shares fell 6.7% as analysts cut targets.

news.headline: Analysts Adjust Price Targets for Robinhood Markets Following Q3 Results
news.summary: Multiple financial institutions, including KeyBanc, JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, and Barclays, adjusted their price targets for Robinhood Markets, Inc. on October 28, 2026.
